articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: The Midterms Are the First Real Test of Whether Markets Beat Pollsters
articles.snippet: Former NBC News political director Chuck Todd is hosting NEXTPredict two weeks before the vote, and has yet to pick a side.

articles.title: ‘Terrifying Precedent’: Dutch Hand US Data From Seized Anti-Fascist Server
articles.snippet: Police seized the Autistici/Inventati server under a 1981 treaty after the U.S. designated the Italian activist group “global terrorists.”

articles.title: UK Trio Jailed Over Home Invasion in Failed Crypto Theft Attempt
